findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name ReDoS vulnerability in regex patterns
 * @description Regular expressions with exponential complexity can lead to ReDoS attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::ExprNode expr
where
  // Look for re.compile calls with potentially dangerous patterns
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember("compile").getACall() and
    expr = call.getArg(0)
  ) or
  // Look for direct regex patterns in re.match, re.search, re.findall, etc.
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "split", "sub", "subn"]).getACall() and
    expr = call.getArg(0)
  )
select expr, "Potentially vulnerable regex pattern that could be susceptible to ReDoS attacks"
findings.hypothesis: ReDoS vulnerability in regex patterns used for URL parsing
